nodes.text:
*Attention Pakistan *

A new virus, HMPV, is spreading rapidly. To protect yourself and those around you, *WEAR A MASK* while traveling... 

By wearing a mask, you can significantly reduce the transmission of HMPV and other respiratory viruses.

*Let's work together🇵🇰
